name: opensquilla-ui-package-workspace

scripts.verify:ui-packages: npm run typecheck:ui-packages && npm run test:ui-packages && npm run build:ui-packages && npm run verify:cross-surface --workspace @opensquilla/ui-tokens && npm run verify:boundaries --workspace @opensquilla/ui-primitives && node scripts/verify_ui_packages.mjs
